scope: Recognizable exterior massing, not surveyed geometry, BIM, interiors or navigation
method: Use project-reviewed plans and primary architectural descriptions for the major spatial relationships; use documented dimensions as anchors. New models are semantic constructions, not vertex-for-vertex traces of the published plans. Intermediate lengths, eaves, smaller supports and surface openings remain approximations unless documented below. Uniform display scaling only.

texture.basis: User-approved generated pale marble, decorative rather than a measured sample of any monument
